fields.description: An image with 1:1 & 2:1 ratio is preferred
fields.label: Logo

fields.description: An icon file with .ico extension. Should be 16 x 16 px. Generated using a favicon generator. [favicon-generator.org]
fields.label: Favicon

fields.description: Show Leads across the CRM. When off, Leads are hidden everywhere and cannot be created or edited; existing lead data is kept.
fields.label: Enable Leads

fields.description: It will make deal's "Expected Closure Date" & "Expected Deal Value" mandatory to get accurate forecasting insights
fields.label: Enable Forecasting

fields.description: Restrict Lead and Deal visibility based on the Sales Hierarchy tree. Managers can see all records owned by or assigned to their reports.
fields.label: Enable Sales Hierarchy Permissions

fields.description: Automatically update "Expected Deal Value" based on the total value of associated products in a deal
fields.label: Auto update Expected Deal Value

fields.description: Time before the event when a reminder notification will be sent by default. This will be applied to all events unless a custom notification is set for a specific event.
fields.label: Default Event Notifications

fields.description: Send an email at every reminder time, together with the in-app notification.
fields.label: Email Reminders

fields.description: Reminders due before this moment are never emailed (no catch-up). Set automatically when reminder emails are switched on.
fields.label: Reminder Emails Enabled On

fields.description: Update the modified timestamp on new email communication & comment for leads & deals
fields.label: Update timestamp on new communication

fields.description: Automatically sets Communication Status to “Replied” for the lead or deal when a response is received. Applies only when SLA is enabled
fields.label: Mark lead/deal as replied on response

fields.description: Automatically sets Communication Status to “Open” for the lead or deal when a new communication is created. Applies only when SLA is enabled
fields.label: Reopen lead/deal on new communication

fields.description: How timestamps are shown in the activity timeline for all users
fields.label: Timeline Timestamp Format

fields.description: Order of activities, emails, comments and calls in the timeline for all users
fields.label: Timeline Sort Order

fields.description: Set once the first admin completes the onboarding persona questionnaire
fields.label: Persona Captured

fields.description: Company assigned to records created outside any tenant (e.g. by Administrator).
fields.label: Default CRM Company

fields.description: When off, users with no company mapping and records with no company stay visible (safe rollout). When on, isolation is absolute.
fields.label: Strict Tenancy Isolation

fields.description: Moving a pipeline to this stage asks for a follow-up date and creates a task with a reminder.
fields.label: Follow-up Stage

fields.description: A daily email to each owner, and their manager, listing pipelines with no activity for the set number of days.
fields.label: Email stuck follow-ups

fields.description: When an event or task reminder fires, also send it on WhatsApp to each CRM user it goes to, at the mobile number on their user profile. Needs the WhatsApp app and an approved template.
fields.label: WhatsApp reminders to the team

fields.description: Name of an approved WhatsApp template. Parameters in order: recipient name, item title, when.
fields.label: Reminder template

fields.description: When a pipeline in the follow-up stage reaches its follow-up date, send its contact a WhatsApp message. Sent once per follow-up date, never late.
fields.label: WhatsApp follow-ups to customers

fields.description: Name of an approved WhatsApp template. Parameters in order: contact first name, owner name, organisation.
fields.label: Follow-up template

fields.description: A message from a number the CRM does not know creates a contact and a pipeline in the first stage, like an inquiry email.
fields.label: Create pipelines from WhatsApp

fields.description: AI screens out junk inquiry emails and, on every new email or WhatsApp message, re-reads the conversation and suggests a stage. Pipelines still start in the entry stage; a person accepts or dismisses each suggestion.
fields.label: Let AI suggest pipeline stages

fields.description: Pipelines created before this are left alone unless older pipelines are included.
fields.label: AI switched on at

fields.description: Also give suggestions on pipelines created before AI was switched on.
fields.label: Include older pipelines

fields.description: AI suggestions and junk decisions below this are ignored.
fields.label: Minimum confidence (%)

fields.description: New pipelines (still in an Open stage such as New) that AI is sure are junk are moved to Junk on their own, with the lost reason filled in. Off: AI only suggests and a person clicks Move.
fields.label: Move junk automatically

fields.description: Only move a pipeline to Junk on its own when AI is at least this sure. Less certain junk stays a suggestion.
fields.label: Move junk at confidence (%)

fields.description: Any OpenAI-compatible API, e.g. Groq or OpenAI.
fields.label: API base URL

fields.description: Leave empty to use groq_api_key from the site config.
fields.label: API key

fields.description: Speech-to-text model for call recordings, e.g. whisper-large-v3-turbo on Groq or whisper-1 on OpenAI.
fields.label: Transcription model

fields.description: Checked before the AI, in order. The first rule whose keywords appear in the latest message decides the suggested stage.
fields.label: Keyword rules
